# bob periods

Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time

```text title="bob periods --help"
Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time

Bare `bob periods` runs the read-only list. ensure creates missing period notes and never edits an existing one. migrate adopts the vault (dry run by default; -a applies one commit).

Usage: bob periods [COMMAND]

Commands:
  brief    Print the agent review bundle for a week, quarter, or year
  draft    Draft a period's Review section (never overwrites Bryan)
  ensure   Create missing period notes one week ahead
  list     List period notes with review states (default)
  migrate  Adopt the period-note tree (dry run by default)
  show     Show a period's live stats and child summaries

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob periods` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob periods brief 2026-W45     Print the agent review bundle for a week
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md  Draft the week's Review section
  bob periods ensure             Create missing notes one week ahead
  bob periods                    List period notes with review states
  bob periods list -k week       List only weekly notes
  bob periods list -p            Report period-note problems
  bob periods show               Show this week's stats strip data
  bob periods show 2026-Q4 -f json  Print the quarter report as JSON
  bob periods ensure -n -f json  Preview the writes as JSON
  bob periods migrate            Preview adopting the period-note tree
  bob periods migrate -a         Apply the adoption in one commit

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, reports, and JSON.
Run 'bob periods <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob periods brief

Print the agent review bundle for a week, quarter, or year

```text title="bob periods brief --help"
Print the deterministic, versioned agent bundle (brief v1) for a week, quarter, or year: header, facts, time, parts, finished, started and dropped, still open, practice (year only), Bryan's words, this note and its neighbours, off-clock counts, and caveats. The command is read-only. all_time has no review. See docs/periods.md for the brief contract and token budgets.

Usage: bob periods brief [OPTIONS] [PERIOD]

Arguments:
  [PERIOD]
          Period id or note path (week, quarter, or year); all_time has no review

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: md (Markdown) or json

          [default: md]
          [possible values: md, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob periods brief 2026-W45
  bob periods brief 2026-Q4 -f json
  bob periods brief 2026 -f md

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE           Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  brief
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage (bad id or flags), or all_time (which has no review)

See docs/periods.md for the brief contract and token budgets.
```

## bob periods draft

Draft a period's Review section (never overwrites Bryan)

```text title="bob periods draft --help"
Replace the `## Review` section of a week, quarter, or year note with the draft text from -i/--input (a file path, or - for stdin). The text must open with a `**Headline:**` line and stay within the kind's word cap (week 250, quarter 400, year 600). An open or future period, or a Review Bryan already edited or reflected, is refused unless -F/--force is passed. The note must exist and contain `## Review`; all_time has no review. See docs/periods.md for the draft rules and JSON errors.

Usage: bob periods draft [OPTIONS] [PERIOD]

Arguments:
  [PERIOD]
          Period id or note path (week, quarter, or year); all_time has no review

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -F, --force
          Draft an open period or overwrite Bryan's edits (Bryan said redo, or asked for so far)

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -i, --input <FILE>
          Draft text file, or - for stdin (required)

  -n, --dry-run
          Plan without writing files

Examples:
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i /tmp/review.md
  bob periods draft 2026-Q4 -i - < review.md
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md -n
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md -F

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  drafted (or planned with -n)
  1  vault I/O or transaction failure
  2  usage (bad id, flags, or draft text)
  3  refused (period open, or state edited/reflected)

See docs/periods.md for the draft rules, word caps, and JSON errors.
```

## bob periods ensure

Create missing period notes one week ahead

```text title="bob periods ensure --help"
Create missing period notes one week ahead: the week, quarter, year, and all-time chains for today (or --date) and for that date plus seven days. Missing notes are created from the deterministic scaffold; existing notes that are empty, whitespace-only, or only frontmatter (the stub a clicked dangling link leaves) are filled. A note with body content is never touched. A re-run writes nothing. With -R/--refresh-instructions, stale agent callouts in existing notes are refreshed in one commit instead. See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods ensure [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --date <DATE>
          ISO date to ensure for, as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

  -n, --dry-run
          Plan without writing files

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -q, --quiet
          Print nothing unless files were written

  -R, --refresh-instructions
          Refresh stale agent callouts in existing period notes (one commit)

Examples:
  bob periods ensure
  bob periods ensure -d 2026-12-28
  bob periods ensure -n -f json
  bob periods ensure -q
  bob periods ensure -R

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  ensured
  1  vault I/O failure or lock busy
  2  usage error

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, and JSON.
```

## bob periods list

List period notes with review states (default)

```text title="bob periods list --help"
List the period notes that exist, newest first, grouped year → quarter → weeks. Each row shows its review-state mark and its Headline. -p/--problems reports dangling daily parents, missing period notes, unscaffolded notes, wrong parents, task rows, and stale instructions. The command is read-only. See docs/periods.md for the review states, problems, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -k, --kind <KIND>
          Show only one period kind

          [possible values: week, quarter, year]

  -p, --problems
          Report period-note problems (read-only)

  -y, --year <YEAR>
          Show only periods in one ISO year, as YYYY

Examples:
  bob periods
  bob periods list
  bob periods list -k week -y 2026
  bob periods list -p
  bob periods list -f json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  list
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage error

See docs/periods.md for the review states and JSON.
```

## bob periods migrate

Adopt the period-note tree (dry run by default)

```text title="bob periods migrate --help"
Adopt the period-note tree: create all_time.md and the ISO week/quarter/year notes in range, adopt in-range year notes (keeping zorg_* keys and archiving the old body), re-parent out-of-range year notes and canonical daily notes, and add the week link on standard prev/next nav lines. Dry run by default. -a/--apply runs one verified vault-rewrite commit. See docs/periods.md for the range, verify, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods migrate [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --apply
          Write the plan and make one verified commit

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -o, --offline
          Commit locally; skip vault sync before and after

  -s, --since <DATE>
          First day of the adoption range, as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the ISO year start

Examples:
  bob periods migrate
  bob periods migrate -s 2025-12-29
  bob periods migrate -a
  bob periods migrate -a -o
  bob periods migrate -a -f json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE           Stats config used by the apply verify
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  planned or adopted
  1  vault I/O or transaction failure
  2  usage error
  3  refused (not a worktree, dirty paths)

See docs/periods.md for the range, verify, and JSON.
```

## bob periods show

Show a period's live stats and child summaries

```text title="bob periods show --help"
Show the stats strip and parts-table data for a week, quarter, year, or all time. With no PERIOD, show the current ISO week. The command is read-only. See docs/periods.md for the JSON contract and aggregation rules.

Usage: bob periods show [OPTIONS] [PERIOD]

Arguments:
  [PERIOD]
          Period id or note path; defaults to the current week

Options:
  -k, --clock <CLOCK>
          Pomodoro clock: worked, off-clock, or total

          [default: worked]
          [possible values: worked, off-clock, total]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob periods show
  bob periods show 2026-W45 -f json
  bob periods show 2026-Q4 -k total
  bob periods show all_time -f json

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE  Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR          Bob vault root; defaults to ~/bob
  BOB_NOW          Local datetime override that pins today for the report
  NO_COLOR         Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  report
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage, unknown period, config error, or non-Dataview task format

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, JSON contract, and display rules.
```
